name: state-diagram
title: StateDiagram
description: An XState machine on a Diagram, drawn as XState's visualizer draws it: the machine as a container with its context, each state a card with its entry and exit actions, invokes and tags as chips, compound and parallel states holding theirs with entry markers, final and history glyphs, and each transition a pill or a card with its guard, actions and delay. A machine, its JSON config or its source; run with stand-ins (what it can take now is a button on its label, its context shown live) and edited, writing to the config. XState and ELK are optional peers.
